## Kevin Cao

### Tenure

### Title

Staff Designer

### Signature

[![KevinCaoSig](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/f/f6/KevinCaoSig.png/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/150?cb=20251029033338)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/f/f6/KevinCaoSig.png/revision/latest?cb=20251029033338)

**Kevin Kai Cao** is a designer who has worked with Mattel since 2007, currently serving as a senior project designer and lead and as a key designer for Hot Wheels Track & Playsets. He first joined the Hot Wheels design team as an intern, and after graduation was hired full time. His first design was the [Cloak and Dagger](/wiki/Cloak_and_Dagger), which was done while on his internship program. He currently acts as a designer for [Matchbox](/wiki/Matchbox).
